name: Conjugate Gradient Solver for Compressive Volume Rendering
aliases: Compressive Volume Rendering with Conjugate Gradient Solver
definition: A method to recover missing pixels in a rendered volume image by solving a regularized least-squares optimization problem using the Conjugate Gradient algorithm.
summary: This method recovers missing pixels in volume rendering by solving a regularized least-squares problem with the Conjugate Gradient algorithm, distinguishing itself by explicitly defining regularization via B-spline convolution and a sampling matrix for pixel dropping.
